title: Disable Flask debug mode in production
context: Refinement notes classic Flask pitfall: app.run(debug=True) in app.py (UNVERIFIED) allows RCE via Werkzeug debugger if exception triggered by malformed request.
decision: Must ensure debug=False in production config (or env-gated), avoiding debug=True.
resolved_by: src/agent1/app.py sets app.config['DEBUG']=False and runs with debug=False.

title: Pin Flask dependency version
context: Dependencies: Flask Python package must be pip-installed; no version pin specified in spec. app.py referenced per spec unverified.
decision: Pin Flask==3.1.3 (matches installed runtime) and Werkzeug==3.1.3 in requirements.txt.
rationale: Ensures reproducible builds and avoids unexpected breaking changes.
resolved_by: Added requirements.txt pinning Flask==3.1.3 and Werkzeug==3.1.3.

title: Adhere to prohibition of external libraries
context: Dependencies: Browser-native HTML5 DnD API; prohibition on external JS/CSS libraries per spec. static/main.js, static/style.css mentioned unverified.
decision: Use only vanilla JS and native APIs, no CDNs/frameworks.
rationale: Meets spec constraint and reduces supply-chain risk.
resolved_by: static/main.js and static/style.css are hand-written vanilla JS/CSS using native DnD API; no external libraries.
